title: SemiNovo: Learning Beyond Search-Identified Spectra for De Novo Peptide Sequencing
abstract: arXiv:2611.21079v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sensitive peptide identification is fundamental to protein characterization and novel protein discovery, for which de novo peptide sequencing (DNPS) from tandem mass spectra provides an important database-independent approach. Although deep learning has substantially advanced de novo sequencing, existing models are predominantly trained on high-confidence peptide-spectrum matches obtained through database search. This search-conditioned supervision excludes a large fraction of unidentified spectra, creating a distribution mismatch between the selectively labeled training data and the complete spectrum stream encountered at inference time, thereby limiting peptide identification performance. To address this challenge, we propose SemiNovo, a semi-supervised framework that learns jointly from identified and unlabeled spectra. translated_title: SemiNovo：超越搜索鉴定谱图学习的从头肽段测序方法
translated_abstract: 敏感的肽段鉴定是蛋白质表征与新蛋白质发现的基础，而基于串联质谱的从头肽段测序（DNPS）为此提供了一种重要的不依赖数据库的方法。尽管深度学习已极大推动了从头测序技术的发展，现有模型主要依赖通过数据库搜索获得的高置信度肽段-谱图匹配进行训练。这种以搜索结果为条件的监督方式排除了大量未被鉴定的谱图，导致经过选择性标注的训练数据与推理时遇到的完整谱图数据流之间存在分布不匹配，从而限制了肽段鉴定的性能。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了SemiNovo，一个能够从已鉴定谱图和未标记谱图中联合学习的半监督框架。SemiNovo首先构建了DarkSpec，一个从（原文截断）收集的大规模、经过质量控制筛选的未标记谱图语料库，
tldr: SemiNovo提出了一种半监督框架，通过联合学习已鉴定谱图与大规模未标记谱图（DarkSpec语料库），克服了传统从头肽段测序仅依赖数据库搜索鉴定结果训练所导致的分布不匹配问题，从而提升肽段鉴定性能。
en_tdlr: SemiNovo is a semi-supervised framework that jointly learns from identified and unlabeled spectra via a large-scale quality-controlled corpus (DarkSpec), overcoming the distribution mismatch caused by training solely on search-identified spectra and improving de novo peptide sequencing performance.
